name: a dropped stream puts the EventSource into CONNECTING (readyState 0) and the UI shows 'Reconnecting'
the browser reconnects on its own and sends Last-Event-ID = the last id it saw
the service answers the resumed stream (Last-Event-ID) with 200 and replays
after the reconnect the UI shows 'Live' again and the new item appears without a manual refresh
the UI retries by itself after the EventSource gave up (new stream request within 20 s)
diagnostic: a manual Live-updates off/on (fresh EventSource without Last-Event-ID) restores Live and shows the missed item
